svg.text: Adriata western cliffside · guest quarters of the Autumn delegation · plans at +38 m and +6 m with section A–A′
Dragonbound Cartographic Suite · Plate I of IV
Drawn for the Autumn delegation · Vanserra household copy
I. MAIN VILLA DECK — CANTILEVERED OVER THE BAY MOUTH (ELEV. +38 m)
38 m sheer drop to the surf
17.8 m cantilever beyond the cliff face
II. LOWER LEVEL — PRINCE'S VAULTED SEA-CAVERN (DIRECTLY BELOW, ELEV. +6 m) · IN REGISTER WITH I
launch due west over open water;
no palace roof, quay or scryer-post
has a line on the arch
III. CLIFFSIDE SECTION A–A′ (W → E, LOOKING NORTH)
palace sightline — all below is blind ground

g.text: ◆ Single bottleneck. One guarded causeway joins the villa to Tarquin's palace. Caelum's door commands the gate hall;
no one reaches either suite unseen.
◆ Private inner corridor. Joins the two suites behind the salon and bolts from within — no crossing the lit glass after
dark, no witness on the deck.
◆ Prince's cover. Sixteen metres of limestone lie between vault and villa. The sea-arch faces due west, blind to palace
◆ The stair. 160 rock-cut treads from Aurelie's lobby, barred on her side. The only other door to the cavern is the sky.
◆ Flight discipline. Launch west over open water, climb beyond the bay mouth before turning, and come home at dusk
